comment: A noise stroke that reverses keeps its streaks straight. On a white 1600 by 1000 document, black, Bristle Flat at a radius of 0.09 of the short side and a pressure of 0.6, with a sample every 4 pixels: three scrubs out and back along a level line at y 200 from x 150 to 950, three out and back along a line slanting down 20 degrees from (150, 520), each return 15 degrees off the way out as a hand scrubs, and one stroke that turns a right corner at (1350, 260). A look of each. Every strand of a scrub runs back along its own line, and the corner keeps its round pivot.
